title: Broadcom's VMSA-2026-0011 fixes 23 vulnerabilities across VMware products, including ESX and vCenter
date_note: Broadcom's advisory is dated by its initial publication day; no earlier day is given.
geo_basis: vendor (Broadcom, advisory publisher); the flaws affect users worldwide
summary: Broadcom published advisory VMSA-2026-0011 on 24 November, fixing 23 vulnerabilities in VMware products. Securityonline lists CVE-2026-123910 as a heap out-of-bounds write and CVE-2026-123911 as a use-after-free. ThaiCERT also lists CVE-2026-123903, an authentication bypass in vCenter's VMware Directory Service, and urges prompt vCenter updates. For ESX and vCenter 7.0 the advisory points to Broadcom support.
plain: Broadcom released fixes for 23 vulnerabilities in VMware products, including ESX and vCenter. Administrators can find the fixed version for each product in the advisory.
exec: Broadcom's advisory fixes 23 vulnerabilities in VMware products such as ESX and vCenter.
action: Broadcom's advisory VMSA-2026-0011 lists the fixed version for each product; apply the fix for your version, and for ESX and vCenter 7.0 contact Broadcom support.

evidence.quote: Broadcom released VMSA-2026-0011 on November 24, 2026, fixing 23 vulnerabilities.
CVE-2026-123910 is a heap out-of-bounds write, and CVE-2026-123911 is a use-after-free.

validation.note: Broadcom's own advisory VMSA-2026-0011 and Securityonline agree on the date and the 23 CVEs.
